question.text: A Rs. 200 cr PMS with AUM rising to Rs. 250 cr quarter-on-quarter faces which incremental compliance requirement (at > Rs. 1,000 cr)?

answer.text: Automated OMS deployment; enhanced audit controls

explanation.text: The Logic: At > Rs. 1,000 cr: automated OMS required; likely board-level risk committee; enhanced reporting. The Trap: Growth-related milestones are routine but have specific regulatory triggers. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B specific. Manager's Pro-Tip: Plan OMS deployment BEFORE crossing Rs. 1,000 cr — retrofitting creates disruption.
